description: Turn on a blog or feed in one step: pass the site (the feed is found from its page) or the feed's own address. From then on, each new item becomes a draft for the brand's usual networks (or account_ids) with the item's title and link as the caption and its picture in the media library, at each account's next good posting time, waiting for approval. The newest item is drafted right away (first_draft). Feeds are checked hourly. No AI writes these captions: rewrite them with feed_drafts and post_update. Adding a feed that's already there turns it back on.

account_ids.description: Accounts its drafts go to; left out: the brand's usual networks

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

match.description: Only items whose title or categories contain one of these words; left out: every new item

url.description: The site, like juniperbakery.com, or its feed's address

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: feed_add
title: Post from a blog
